metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Script and Sans-Serif Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with her head tilted back and eyes closed, positioned centrally against a dark, vignetted background. The lighting is directional, creating a bright highlight on the face and shoulder while casting deep shadows. Two layers of text are centered at the top: a delicate pink script and a large, thin white geometric sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the soft, organic curves of the subject and the rigid geometry of the sans-serif type.
Relationship between the bright facial highlights and the deep, textured shadows of the background.
Interaction between the pink script and the white sans-serif, creating a layered hierarchy.
coreInvariants: Monochrome color palette for the image
Subject with closed eyes and tilted head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium-close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's illuminated face and shoulder serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face, moves upward to the text, and then follows the line of the hair down the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark negative space on the left and right margins to emphasize the central subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark gray tones provide the background and shadow depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white highlights on the skin and the primary text provide high contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft dusty pink is used for the secondary script text to add a subtle pop of color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the image; low saturation in the pink accent.

letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif: Hairline weight, wide proportions, open counters, and sharp vertices.
Script: Monolinear stroke, upright posture, connected lowercase letters, and looped ascenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the sans-serif has a high crossbar.
The script 'Y' has a large, sweeping loop.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, modern sans-serif and a soft, personal script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, geometric, and ultra-thin look for the display text.
Captures the monolinear, upright script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with a high ponytail, head tilted back, eyes closed, lit from above to create bright highlights on the face and deep shadows on the neck and background. The background should be a dark, slightly textured gray with a heavy vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the top. The top line is a dusty pink monolinear script. The second line is a large, white, hairline geometric sans-serif in all caps with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochrome except for the pink text?
Is the sans-serif text extremely thin and wide?
Is the lighting dramatic with deep shadows?
Is the text centered and top-aligned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink accent color
Tracking width of the sans-serif text
Degree of vignetting in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Smooth gradients in the skin highlights
Deep, rich blacks in the shadows

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pink text is legible against the dark background.
Check that the hairline font hasn't disappeared into the background texture.
Verify the high-contrast lighting doesn't blow out facial details.
Confirm the composition remains centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W portrait with a dual-font typographic stack (thin geometric sans + monoline script) centered at the top, using a single pastel accent color for the script.
